fields.name: Wireless Bluetooth Noise Cancelling Headphones
fields.description: Experience theater-grade sound with the AeroGlide ANC headphones. Equipped with custom tuned 40mm neodymium drivers, spatial audio algorithms, and plush memory foam ear cushions for all-day comfort. Features fast USB-C charging giving 5 hours of playback in 10 minutes.
fields.short_description: 40dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation with 50-hour ultra battery life.

fields.name: Vanguard Ultra Slim 15.6" Gaming Laptop
fields.description: Engineered for seamless productivity and entertainment. Crafted in a featherlight unibody aerospace aluminum chassis weighing just 1.4kg. Vibrant 100% sRGB anti-glare display with precision trackpad and full-day 11-hour battery life.
fields.short_description: Fast 16GB LPDDR5, 512GB NVMe SSD, Quad-Core Ultra processor with backlit keyboard.

fields.name: Nova 5G Pro Flagship Smartphone
fields.description: Capture life in razor sharp clarity with the 108MP AI triple camera array. Powered by a massive 5000mAh battery that charges from 0 to 100% in 38 minutes. Dual stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos sound.
fields.short_description: 120Hz FHD+ AMOLED display, 67W Turbo Charge, Dimensity octa-core 5G SoC.

fields.name: Titan Edge OLED Fitness Smart Watch
fields.description: A timeless wardrobe essential crafted from 100% long-staple combed cotton. Soft pre-washed finish prevents shrinkage while maintaining crisp collar structure across multiple washes.
fields.short_description: Breathable combed cotton with tailored regular fit and button-down collar.

fields.name: BoomBlast Portable Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker
fields.description: Exude effortless grace with this breathable georgette Anarkali set. Features zari embroidered round neckline, 3/4 sleeves, and flared kalis that drape elegantly for festive and casual occasions.
fields.short_description: Hand-printed delicate floral motifs with matching dupatta and churidar.

fields.name: ErgoGrip Wireless Optical Mouse
fields.description: Step into unparalleled energy return with CloudStride sneakers. High-traction rubber outsole offers confident grip on road and trail surfaces while ortholite anti-microbial insoles keep your feet fresh.
fields.short_description: Responsive nitrogen-infused EVA midsole with breathable engineered mesh.

fields.name: RGB Backlit Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
fields.description: Triple layered body combines an aluminum core sandwiched between heavy-gauge food grade steel. Includes frying pan, deep kadai with tempered glass lid, and sauce pan.
fields.short_description: Induction-friendly 18/10 food-grade steel with uniform heat distribution.

fields.name: Zenith Tab 11" 2K IPS Tablet with Stylus
fields.description: Formulated with cold-pressed botanical extracts, Kakadu plum, ferulic acid, and multi-molecular hyaluronic acid. Dermatologically tested, vegan, paraben-free, and cruelty-free.
fields.short_description: Brightens dark spots, firms fine lines, and deeply hydrates with 15% active ethyl ascorbic acid.

fields.name: PowerCore 20000mAh 22.5W Fast Charge Power Bank
fields.description: Hand-sorted premium jumbo grade nuts rich in healthy unsaturated fats, plant protein, and dietary fiber. Zero trans fats and zero artificial preservatives.
fields.short_description: Himalayan pink salt dry-roasted dry fruits in vacuum sealed resealable pouch.

fields.name: 65W GaN Dual Port USB-C Fast Wall Charger
fields.description: Certified non-toxic, odorless eco-TPE foam provides optimal cushioning for spine, hips, and joints during intense workouts, pilates, and yoga practices.
fields.short_description: Alignment lines guide posture with sweat-resistant textured anti-tear grip.

fields.name: Men's Premium 100% Breathable Cotton Casual Shirt
fields.description: Designed for smart-casual Fridays and evening outings. Features curved hemline, pearlized buttons, and reinforced double stitching for timeless durability.
fields.short_description: Soft-washed pre-shrunk pure combed cotton with modern slim spread collar.

fields.name: Men's CloudStride Cushion Engineered Running Shoes
fields.description: High-traction anti-skid rubber outsole grips road and gym floors. Padded collar and anatomical arch support minimize impact during long distance runs.
fields.short_description: Ultra-responsive rebound EVA midsole with breathable engineered flyknit mesh upper.

fields.name: Women's Royal Embroidered Anarkali Cotton Kurti
fields.description: Handcrafted by artisan weavers using breathable premium viscose rayon. Features elegant three-quarter sleeves and mandarin keyhole collar.
fields.short_description: Graceful flared silhouette adorned with zari threadwork and gota patti borders.

fields.name: Women's Handwoven Kanjeevaram Silk Saree with Blouse Piece
fields.description: A treasured masterpiece for weddings and festive celebrations. Comes with an unstitched 80cm brocade matching blouse piece.

fields.name: Women's Structured Vegan Leather Shoulder Handbag
fields.description: Spacious water-resistant luxury vegan leather fits tablet, wallet, makeup kit, and essentials with smooth zippered security.
fields.short_description: Triple compartment tote with gold-tone hardware and detachable shoulder strap.

fields.name: Men's Classic Slim-Fit Stretch Denim Jeans
fields.description: Reinforced rivets, durable YKK brass zipper fly, and classic 5-pocket styling. Resists fading wash after wash.

fields.name: Kids Organic Cotton Play Graphic T-Shirt
fields.description: Durable rib knit neckband and tagless neck label for scratch-free daily play sessions.

fields.name: Women's Minimalist White Platform Casual Sneakers

fields.short_description: Comfortable memory foam footbed with easy wipe-clean synthetic leather upper.

fields.name: Barista Touch Espresso & Filter Coffee Maker Machine

fields.name: Stainless Steel 1.8L Rapid Boil Electric Kettle

fields.name: 5-Piece Granite Non-Stick Induction Cookware Set

fields.name: Glamour Sequin Embroidered Net Party Gown

fields.description: Expertly sculpted shoulders with clean peak lapels and tortoiseshell buttons. Fabricated in a mid-weight stretch twill that maintains sharp drape throughout long workdays.

fields.name: Classic Analog Chronograph Watch with Genuine Leather Strap

fields.name: Polarized UV400 Aviator Metal Sunglasses

fields.short_description: 40dB Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation with 50-hour ultra battery life.

fields.description: Unleash elite gaming and creative performance. Packed with a 165Hz QHD IPS anti-glare display, dual-fan vapor chamber cooling, per-key RGB backlit keyboard, and lightweight aerospace-grade aluminum chassis.
fields.short_description: Intel Core i7 13th Gen, 16GB DDR5, 1TB NVMe SSD, RTX 4060 8GB Graphics.

fields.name: Nova 5G Pro Flagship Smartphone
fields.description: Captivating design engineered for photography enthusiasts and power multitaskers. Features Snapdragon 8-series processor, 5000mAh all-day battery, stereo Dolby Atmos speakers, and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus.
fields.short_description: 108MP OIS Studio Camera, 120Hz Curved AMOLED, 67W Super Fast Charging.

fields.name: Titan Edge OLED Fitness Smart Watch
fields.description: Your comprehensive wellness partner on your wrist. Continuous SpO2 and heart-rate monitoring, AI sleep scoring, IP68 water resistance, and up to 10 days of battery on a single magnetic charge.
fields.short_description: 1.96" Ultra AMOLED Display, Bluetooth Calling, 110+ Sports Modes.

fields.name: BoomBlast Portable Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker
fields.description: Take the festival anywhere. Engineered with dual passive radiators for deep resonant bass, rugged rubberized armor shock protection, TWS stereo pairing mode, and hands-free microphone calls.
fields.short_description: 24W Punchy Bass, IPX7 Waterproof, 20-Hour Playtime with RGB Lights.

fields.name: Men's CloudStride Cushion Engineered Running Shoes
fields.description: Experience cloud-like shock absorption during sprints and daily walks. Features breathable zoned mesh knit, anti-slip carbon rubber outsole pods, and orthotic arch support insole.
fields.short_description: Engineered air-mesh upper with high-rebound EVA responsive midsole.

fields.name: Barista Touch Espresso & Filter Coffee Maker Machine
fields.description: Brew cafe-quality lattes, cappuccinos, and rich crema espressos at home. Featuring Thermo-Block rapid heating system, dual-wall crema filters, removable 1.5L water tank, and cup warming plate.
fields.short_description: 15-Bar Italian high pressure pump with stainless steel milk steam frother wand.

fields.name: Signature Artisanal Eau De Parfum Luxury Fragrance 100ml
fields.description: A long-lasting artisanal perfume formulated with concentrated natural essential oils. Features top notes of bergamot and pink pepper, heart notes of rose and amber, settling into a warm sandalwood finish.
fields.short_description: Sensual blend of Calabrian bergamot, Turkish rose, and rich Madagascar vanilla.

fields.name: ProFlex Non-Slip Dual Layer Eco TPE Yoga Mat (6mm)
fields.description: Eco-friendly certified non-toxic TPE material with textured grip surface on both sides. Provides superior joint cushioning, sweat resistance, and includes a convenient free carrying strap.
fields.short_description: High-density 6mm cushioned anti-tear yoga mat with laser-engraved alignment lines.
